##### Project general facts

Sequoia, unveiled by Arada, presents an exclusive collection of luxury townhouses and signature villas that embody a contemporary woodland aesthetic. The development embraces modern architecture, allowing each residence to integrate seamlessly with the surrounding forested setting. Residents are offered a distinctive living concept that blends elegant design with the tranquility of natural greenery.

The community is enriched by expansive forested zones where walking trails intertwine with trees, creating an immersive outdoor experience. Dedicated running tracks, cycling lanes, yoga decks, picnic clearings, and meditation corners encourage an active and health‑focused lifestyle. Additional recreation spaces include playgrounds and entertainment areas that cater to families and individuals alike.

Interiors feature modern finishing with high‑quality materials, delivering a cohesive and refined ambience throughout each home. Kitchens arrive fully equipped, ready to support effortless culinary endeavors. The residences are presented unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

Tilal is situated within the vibrant Masaar enclave of Sharjah, a green community celebrated for its forested landscape and more than fifty thousand trees. Nearby amenities such as the Masaar Discovery Center, a show villa, a water play area, Zad food truck park, skate park, and a full retail and dining hub provide convenient leisure options. An anchor supermarket and additional retail outlets ensure everyday necessities are within easy reach.

The neighbourhood’s design promotes wellness through an extensive network of forest walks and outdoor sports facilities. Residents enjoy exclusive access to a five kilometre looping woodland cycling trail that weaves through the community’s green spine, while a six point six kilometre professional cycling circuit encircles the wider area. A twelve kilometre stretch of scenic cycling paths invites exploration of the spacious woodland surroundings.

Educational needs are well served by a large international school and a nursery located within the development. The area is part of a master‑planned collection of seven gated communities, each offering abundant green space and a balanced mix of work and leisure opportunities. Overall, Tilal delivers a harmonious blend of urban convenience and natural serenity for its inhabitants.
